claim: TDK announces 150 nm meta-optic mirror prototype for retinal-projection smart glasses
summary: TDK's October 2 manufacturer announcement says it demonstrated a direct-retinal-projection smart-glasses prototype with a 150 nm flat meta-optic mirror embedded in a lens and approximately 80% visible-light transmission. The current mirror demonstration is monochrome; the cited 4K-capable laser-control technology and future full-color goal must not be misrepresented as a 4K full-color glasses prototype. TDK plans to exhibit the prototype at CEATEC from October 13. Treat claimed first-of-kind, transparency, eye-box/visual quality and manufacturability as manufacturer assertions pending independent measurements; this is an enabling optical technology, not a buyable glasses model.
